items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: Do you remember Dick Johnson's place over there? Never did. I don't remember his place.

ctx.x: You've been here all that time. That's right. Nine years.

That's right. I did. When I first came out here in 49 I opened up a little cafe on Avalon. Avalon. Avalon near Voynon. It was a very small place. Do you remember Dick Johnson's place over there? Never did. I don't remember his place. He gave it up about that time.
I think he left. Well, this fellow, Dink Johnson. Dink Johnson used to be a bass player. I don't remember. That's Bill. That's Bill Johnson.
